request.style: English, acoustic singer-songwriter, soft warm female vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, piano, light strings, quiet and reverent, 74 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hannah wept at Shiloh and her lips moved with no sound
Old Eli thought she'd had the wine, but grief had brought her down
She came back with a little boy and gave him with both hands
I prayed for this child
So now I give him to the LORD

[Verse]
In those days the word of the LORD was rare
The lamp of God had not yet gone out
The boy lay in the temple in the quiet midnight air
When a voice called out his name and he ran to Eli's side
Here I am; you called me

[Chorus]
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
In the stillness of the night
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Till the lamp gives way to light

[Verse]
Years went by and Samuel came with oil to Bethlehem
Seven sons passed by him, and the LORD chose none of them
They sent out for the youngest one who kept the sheep that day
Rise and anoint him; this is the one

[Bridge]
Man looks at the outward appearance
But the LORD looks at the heart
Man looks at the outward appearance
But the LORD looks at the heart

[Chorus]
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
In the stillness of the night
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Till the lamp gives way to light

[Outro]
Speak, LORD
For your servant is listening
